name: Visa Gold Card
summary: Internationally recognised card for ATMs and Visa POS terminals, pre-funded for local and international use.
benefits: Currently works as a debit card, pre-funded for use locally or internationally
Access funds through ATMs and Visa POS terminals
Instant payments with no clearing period
eligibility: Open to account holders and non-account holders
Open to companies, where cards are funded from an existing corporate account
